scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,amber "WEB_PORT=${WEB_PORT:-3020} npm run dev --workspace=@rosevarzan/web" "WEB_ORIGIN=${WEB_ORIGIN:-http://localhost:${WEB_PORT:-3020}} npm run dev --workspace=@rosevarzan/api"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@rosevarzan/web && npm run build --workspace=@rosevarzan/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@rosevarzan/web && npm run typecheck --workspace=@rosevarzan/api
